rules: Same456 observations. Reproduce noisy-weight NLM risks1e-12 after refactoring shared weight generator. For EACH fixed weight field,apply same weights to noisy input and true signal. Error=signal distortion+weighted noise;MSE=distortion MSE+noise MSE+2cross,verified1e-12. Also compute weights from clean truth ORACLE with floor0,not noise floor subtraction,then still average NOISY pixels. h=.4/.8 unchanged,patch5/search21,selfweight=maxothers. No truth output substitution or parameter fitting.
limitations: Signal distortion is per-realization term,not statistical bias squared when weights depend on noise. Cross term retained;weighted-noise component need not be zero mean for noisy weights. Clean weights are diagnostic oracle,not deployable filter or guaranteed lower-risk bound at fixed h. Known Gaussian covariance/scale,not real RCD or photography validation. No production changes.
